coverage: All 1,560 OneMap island features are searchable, including resorts, uninhabited and reclaimed islands. The 429 unnamed registry features are searchable by FCODE. Atoll fills dissolve only island land, never lagoons or administrative sea buffers. Government island registry snapshot: May 2024. Local areas are clipped to their displayed parent and residual source gaps are reconciled within that parent. Inland lake water is excluded; coastlines have no border stroke. Population is not inferred by distributing national totals.
processing: Retained source bytes are verified by SHA-256. Administrative polygons are cleaned together at 0.00012-degree simplification; Maldives island footprints retain government source resolution. Complete neighboring outline arcs share projected endpoints and previously established junctions. Local areas are clipped individually on a mic degree lattice, with source gaps assigned within their displayed parent. Lake masks preserve the 56 mapped Lake Tana islands. Coastlines have no border stroke. Only selected-parent local geometry loads.

No older Burundi province population is transferred to the new five provinces. National GDP is never allocated to subdivisions.
